cmd: f=$(find . -name '*.sh' -not -path './node_modules/*' -not -path './.git/*' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; awk '/trap/ && /EXIT/ {c[FILENAME]++} END {bad=0; for (fn in c) if (c[fn]>1) {print "double-EXIT-trap: " fn; bad=1} exit bad}' "$f"
grep -rnE '#.*\|\| *FAIL' --include='*.sh' --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git . && { echo 'guard-swallow: || FAIL 被注释吞（防线假活）'; exit 1; } || exit 0

grep -rnE 'docker exec .*-e +PGPASSWORD=' --include='*.sh' --include='*.py' --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git . && { echo 'cred-expose: PGPASSWORD 经 docker exec -e 暴露进程列表'; exit 1; } || exit 0
